title.en: Arrivals and overnight stays in holiday homes and collective accommodation by month
title.de: Ankünfte und Logiernächte in Ferienwohnungen und Kollektivunterkünften nach Monat
title.fr: Arrivées et nuitées dans des logements de vacances et des hébergements collectifs selon le mois
title.it: Arrivi e pernottamenti in abitazioni di vacanza e alloggi collettivi per mese

details.en:
Monthly data on arrivals and overnight stays in holiday homes and collective
accommodation by type of accommodation and guest origin, since 2017.
Source: FSO survey PASTA (statistics on supplementary accommodation).
Sourced from the Swiss Stats Explorer SDMX API,
dataflow CH1.PASTA:DF_PASTA_552_MONTHLY(1.0.0), https://stats.swiss.
The cube is sparse: arrivals (20101) and overnight stays (20201) are
published as a weighted sum (sumw) with a confidence interval (ci), while
length of stay (20401) is published as a weighted value (valuew) only.
details.de:
Monatsdaten der Ankünfte und Logiernächte in Ferienwohnungen und
Kollektivunterkünften nach Beherbergungstyp und Gästeherkunft, seit 2017.
Quelle: BFS-Erhebung PASTA (Parahotellerie-Statistik).
Bezogen über die SDMX-API des Swiss Stats Explorer,
Dataflow CH1.PASTA:DF_PASTA_552_MONTHLY(1.0.0), https://stats.swiss.
details.fr:
Chiffres mensuels des arrivées et nuitées dans des logements de vacances et
des hébergements collectifs selon le type d'hébergement et l'origine des
hôtes, depuis 2017.
Source: enquête OFS PASTA (statistique de la parahôtellerie).
Obtenu via l'API SDMX du Swiss Stats Explorer,
dataflow CH1.PASTA:DF_PASTA_552_MONTHLY(1.0.0), https://stats.swiss.
details.it:
Dati mensili per gli arrivi e i pernottamenti in abitazioni di vacanza e
alloggi collettivi secondo il tipo di alloggio e l'origine degli ospiti,
dal 2017.
Fonte: rilevazione UST PASTA (statistica del settore paralberghiero).
Ottenuto tramite l'API SDMX dello Swiss Stats Explorer,
dataflow CH1.PASTA:DF_PASTA_552_MONTHLY(1.0.0), https://stats.swiss.
